source.author: Wowhead Looter pooled uploads

notes: The source's indexed 'Disenchanted from' Looter table shows Azurite Ring 25045, Arcane Dust 22445, 2,792 material-positive occurrences among 3,655 reported gear processing events (displayed 76%). These are source-reported Looter denominators rather than individually read-back physical casts; 2,792 is NOT a total quantity, no overall zero-outcome count and no 0-N/positive-stack histogram is given. Original TBC Classic ring is uncommon iLvl84 (https://www.wowhead.com/tbc/item=25045/azurite-ring), but the page is displayed on PTR 12.1.7 and modern scaled item level differs; these data are not verified as current Retail outcomes. The distinct RIKU6 Enchantrix 25045:0:-10 record already exists and could overlap Wowhead pooled submissions; do not pool without a source-lineage audit. Unknown skill, specialization, exact collection patch, item suffix and player profile remain null.
